_definition: ops per loaded byte as the roofline tool defines it for its fed-matrix rows: matrix-operation count (2*m*n*k per MulAdd) divided by the bytes read by coopMatLoad for the A and B operands. Counted per subgroup per outer K iteration (chunk) of the kernel's main loop, from the kernel source of build topic4 (loop nest: for each K slab: load all A; for each B: load B; for each A: MulAdd); the static OpCooperativeMatrixLoadKHR / MulAddKHR counts of the SPIR-V agree (isa/kernel-coopmat-types.csv).

sarc_linear_q4gsw_coopmat_orin_t256x128k.derivation: subgroup tile 128x32 = 8x2 accumulators, K 16 per chunk: 8 A + 2 B loads of 16x16 fp16 (512 B), 16 MulAdd: 16*8192/(10*512)

sarc_dev_linear_q4gsw_coopmat_bx_t128x12.derivation: subgroup tile 64x32 = 4x2 accumulators, K 32 per chunk in 2 slabs: 2*4 A + 2*2 B loads, 2*2*4 MulAdd: 16*8192/(12*512)

sarc_linear_dq8ca_coopmat_zpgtr_orin_bf_.derivation: subgroup tile 32x64 = 2x4 accumulators, K 64 per chunk in 2 slabs of 32: 2*2 A (16x32 int8) + 2*4 B (32x16 int8) loads of 512 B, 2*4*2 MulAdd: 16*16384/(12*512)

sarc_dev_orin_sdpa_fused3sb_d64_t32x32g1.feed: storage buffer (K, V tiles) + shared (exp scores); Q in registers
sarc_dev_orin_sdpa_fused3sb_d64_t32x32g1.derivation: per 32x32 block: QK^T 2*2*4 = 16 MulAdd with 8 K tiles from the buffer, eV 2*4*2 = 16 MulAdd with 8 V tiles from the buffer and 4 e tiles from shared: 32*8192/(20*512)

sarc_dev_orin_sdpa_fused3sb_d128_t16x64g.feed: storage buffer (K, V tiles) + shared (exp scores); Q in registers
sarc_dev_orin_sdpa_fused3sb_d128_t16x64g.derivation: per 16x64 block: QK^T 1*4*8 = 32 MulAdd with 32 K tiles, eV 1*8*4 = 32 MulAdd with 32 V tiles and 4 e tiles from shared: 64*8192/(68*512)
